summary: Searches a container's array of 7-dword-stride elements for an ID value equal to a2 and returns the zero-based element index, or -1 when no element matches. The element count is read from the container at offset 108 and the array base pointer at offset 8 (elements are examined starting 4 bytes into that array). Called by NetworkConnection.

operations.description: Reads the element count from the container at offset 108
Returns -1 when the element count is not positive
Iterates over the 7-dword-stride elements starting from the base pointer at offset 8 plus 4, comparing each element's first dword to a2
Returns -1 when the scan index reaches the element count without a match
Returns the element index when the element's first dword equals a2
